title: top-up: TokenEconomizer learnings persistence
definition: Review that the learnings pull copies only verified private store state into the home and reports refused, unavailable, empty or restored truthfully, that the push mirrors only the allow-listed state of the run's own key, scans the staged files with gitleaks before committing, re-checks the stop latch and visibility before each push attempt, isolates other repository keys, and keeps its scratch clone only after a pushed or unchanged outcome.
